description: Details pursuant to partial discharge of conditions 22 (Piling Method Statement), 27 (microclimate Mitigation Measures) and 35 (Sound Insulation Measures), of Full Planning Permission application reference 24/1804 dated 18/12/2025 for Hybrid planning application comprising: Full planning permission for the demolition of all existing buildings and structures and all site preparation works. phased Redevelopment within Phase 1 with mixed-use buildings providing residential homes (Use Class C3), flexible commercial, retail and leisure space (Class E),workspace (Use Class E(g)), associated cycle and vehicle parking, new and altered vehicular accesses and other associated highways works, hard and soft landscaping including creation of new and upgrades to existing public open space, and all associated ancillary and engineering works; and Outline planning permission for the phased redevelopment within Phase 2 with a series of new mixed-use buildings accommodating residential homes (Use Class C3), flexible commercial, retail, workspace and leisure space (Class E), community space (Use Class F), and flexible nursery/community/medical floorspace (Use Classes F/E(e)/E(f)), associated cycle and vehicle parking, new and altered vehicular accesses and other associated highways works, hard and soft landscaping including creation of new and upgrades to existing public open space, and all associated ancillary and engineering works, with all matters reserved except for means of access.Subject to Deed of Agreement dated 18 December 2025 under Section 106 of Town and Country Planning Act, 1990 as amended
site_name: College of North West London Willesden, Dudden Hill Lane, London, NW10 2XD
